# SPEC 2.1: constant evaluation uses the target integer widths. int and uint are
# 32 bits on 386 and arm and 64 bits on amd64 and wasm. A value that wraps at run
# time on the target wraps the same way at compile time, and a typed constant
# result that does not fit the target width fails with [correctness::const_eval].
env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
env CGO_ENABLED=0

cd m

env GOARCH=amd64
logos run ./wrap
cmp stdout want-wrap-amd64.txt
logos run ./over
cmp stdout want-over-amd64.txt
logos run ./overlib
cmp stdout want-overlib-amd64.txt
! logos build -o uptr.exe ./uptr
stderr '\[correctness::const_eval\] uintptr type in const func'

env GOARCH=386
logos run ./wrap
cmp stdout want-wrap-386.txt
! logos build -o over.exe ./over
stderr 'over/main\.lgo:16:7: \[correctness::const_eval\] constant 2147483648 overflows int in const evaluation'
stderr 'over/main\.lgo:17:7: \[correctness::const_eval\] constant 4294967296 overflows int in const evaluation'
stderr 'over/main\.lgo:18:7: \[correctness::const_eval\] constant shift result overflows int in const evaluation'
stderr 'over/main\.lgo:19:7: \[correctness::const_eval\] constant 2147483648 overflows int in const evaluation'
stderr 'over/main\.lgo:20:7: \[correctness::const_eval\] constant 4294967296 overflows uint in const evaluation'
stderr 'over/main\.lgo:21:7: \[correctness::const_eval\] constant -3221225472 overflows int in const evaluation'
! logos build -o overlib.exe ./overlib
stderr 'overlib/main\.lgo:9:7: \[correctness::const_eval\] constant 2147483648 overflows int in const evaluation'
stderr 'overlib/main\.lgo:10:7: \[correctness::const_eval\] constant 4294967296 overflows int in const evaluation'
stderr 'overlib/main\.lgo:11:7: \[correctness::const_eval\] constant shift result overflows int in const evaluation'
stderr 'overlib/main\.lgo:12:7: \[correctness::const_eval\] constant 2147483648 overflows int in const evaluation'
stderr 'overlib/main\.lgo:13:7: \[correctness::const_eval\] constant 4294967296 overflows uint in const evaluation'
stderr 'overlib/main\.lgo:14:7: \[correctness::const_eval\] constant -3221225472 overflows int in const evaluation'
! logos build -o uptr.exe ./uptr
stderr '\[correctness::const_eval\] uintptr type in const func'

env GOARCH=arm
! logos build -o over.exe ./over
stderr 'over/main\.lgo:16:7: \[correctness::const_eval\] constant 2147483648 overflows int in const evaluation'
stderr 'over/main\.lgo:20:7: \[correctness::const_eval\] constant 4294967296 overflows uint in const evaluation'
! logos build -o overlib.exe ./overlib
stderr 'overlib/main\.lgo:9:7: \[correctness::const_eval\] constant 2147483648 overflows int in const evaluation'
stderr 'overlib/main\.lgo:13:7: \[correctness::const_eval\] constant 4294967296 overflows uint in const evaluation'

env GOOS=wasip1
env GOARCH=wasm
logos build -o over.wasm ./over
logos build -o overlib.wasm ./overlib

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/ctfew

go 1.27

-- m/lib/lib.lgo --
package lib

const func C1G() int   { return 1 << 30 }
const func C64K() int  { return 1 << 16 }
const func C1() int    { return 1 }
const func CU31() uint { return 1 << 31 }
const func Sum() int   { return C1G() + C1G() }
const func Prod() int  { return C64K() * C64K() }
const func ShlW() int  { return C1() << 32 }
const func Shl31() int { return C1() << 31 }
const func SumU() uint { return CU31() + CU31() }
const func Neg() int   { return -C1G() - C1G() - C1G() }

const func MulWrap(a, b int) int     { return a * b }
const func NarrowUint(n uint64) uint { return uint(n) }
-- m/over/main.lgo --
package main

import "fmt"

const func C1G() int   { return 1 << 30 }
const func C64K() int  { return 1 << 16 }
const func C1() int    { return 1 }
const func CU31() uint { return 1 << 31 }
const func Sum() int   { return C1G() + C1G() }
const func Prod() int  { return C64K() * C64K() }
const func ShlW() int  { return C1() << 32 }
const func Shl31() int { return C1() << 31 }
const func SumU() uint { return CU31() + CU31() }
const func Neg() int   { return -C1G() - C1G() - C1G() }

const sum = Sum()
const prod = Prod()
const shlw = ShlW()
const shl31 = Shl31()
const sumu = SumU()
const neg = Neg()

func main() {
	fmt.Println(int64(sum), int64(prod), int64(shlw), int64(shl31), uint64(sumu), int64(neg))
}
-- m/overlib/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/ctfew/lib"
)

const sum = lib.Sum()
const prod = lib.Prod()
const shlw = lib.ShlW()
const shl31 = lib.Shl31()
const sumu = lib.SumU()
const neg = lib.Neg()

func main() {
	fmt.Println(int64(sum), int64(prod), int64(shlw), int64(shl31), uint64(sumu), int64(neg))
}
-- m/wrap/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"os"

	"example.com/ctfew/lib"
)

const func ShlHigh(n int) int        { return n << 31 }
const func ShlWord(n int) int        { return n << 32 }
const func ShrWord(n int) int        { return n >> 32 }
const func MulWrap(a, b int) int     { return a * b }
const func AddWrap(a, b int) int     { return a + b }
const func DivMin(a, b int) int      { return a / b }
const func Mix(a, b int) int         { return a*b + a<<30 }
const func SubWrap(a, b uint) uint   { return a - b }
const func NarrowInt(n int64) int    { return int(n) }
const func NarrowUint(n uint64) uint { return uint(n) }

const shlHigh = ShlHigh(1)
const shlWord = ShlWord(1)
const shrWord = ShrWord(-5)
const mulWrap = MulWrap(65536, 65536)
const addWrap = AddWrap(2147483647, 1)
const divMin = DivMin(-2147483648, -1)
const mix = Mix(3, 2147483647)
const subWrap = SubWrap(0, 1)
const narrowInt = NarrowInt(4294967301)
const narrowUint = NarrowUint(18446744073709551615)

const impMul = lib.MulWrap(65536, 65536)
const impNarrow = lib.NarrowUint(18446744073709551615)

var failed bool

func signed(name string, c, r int64) {
	fmt.Printf("%s const=%d run=%d\n", name, c, r)
	if c != r {
		failed = true
	}
}

func unsigned(name string, c, r uint64) {
	fmt.Printf("%s const=%d run=%d\n", name, c, r)
	if c != r {
		failed = true
	}
}

func main() {
	one := len(os.Args)
	signed("shlHigh", int64(shlHigh), int64(ShlHigh(one)))
	signed("shlWord", int64(shlWord), int64(ShlWord(one)))
	signed("shrWord", int64(shrWord), int64(ShrWord(-5*one)))
	signed("mulWrap", int64(mulWrap), int64(MulWrap(65536*one, 65536)))
	signed("addWrap", int64(addWrap), int64(AddWrap(2147483647*one, 1)))
	signed("divMin", int64(divMin), int64(DivMin(-2147483648*one, -one)))
	signed("mix", int64(mix), int64(Mix(3, 2147483647*one)))
	unsigned("subWrap", uint64(subWrap), uint64(SubWrap(0, uint(one))))
	signed("narrowInt", int64(narrowInt), int64(NarrowInt(4294967301*int64(one))))
	unsigned("narrowUint", uint64(narrowUint), uint64(NarrowUint(18446744073709551615*uint64(one))))
	signed("impMul", int64(impMul), int64(lib.MulWrap(65536*one, 65536)))
	unsigned("impNarrow", uint64(impNarrow), uint64(lib.NarrowUint(18446744073709551615*uint64(one))))
	if failed {
		os.Exit(1)
	}
}
-- m/uptr/main.lgo --
package main

const ptrs = []uintptr{1}

func main() { _ = ptrs }
